title: SearchFilter
summary: The search field keeps its teal focused look while the list is open, even when you Tab into a row. Rows are 4px-radius instead of square, show a teal ring for keyboard focus, and the selected check pops in. The panel grows from the corner that touches the field (bottom corner when it flips above).
why: Task brief research summary (HeroUI, Mantine, shadcn/ui, Untitled UI, React Aria, Fluent): 'modern' here comes from connectedness and polish, not flashy motion. (Not re-researched in this pass.)
Connectedness: measured before, Tab-ing from the field into a row removed the teal border and glow from the field while the list was still open.
Concentric radii (inner radius = outer radius - padding): the panel is 8px with 4px padding, so rows should be 4px. Measured before: Select and Creatable rows 6px, Dropdown and SearchFilter rows 0px.
Measured before: with the panel flipped above the field, its transform-origin was still 0 0 (top-left), so it grew away from the field instead of out of it.
Selection feedback should be acknowledged briefly: the same fade + 85% to 100% scale as the v2 Checkbox tick, 180ms.

scenarioLabels.03-hover-row: Open, mouse hover on a row
scenarioLabels.04-keyboard-row: Tab from the field to the first row

motion.before: no visible motion (fade/zoom cancelled by a utility-order bug)
motion.after: 200ms: opacity 0 to 100%, scale 98% to 100%, 4px slide down, origin top left, spring ease (--v2-ease-spring; sampled critically damped curve, fallback cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1))
180ms opacity 0 to 100% + scale 85% to 100%, spring ease (--v2-ease-spring; sampled critically damped curve, fallback cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1))

states: Field / default / open: focused look held (also under hover and while a row has focus)
Option row / keyboard-focused: NEW fill #F5F5F5 + inside stroke 1px #27ABB8
Option row / mouse hover: fill #F5F5F5 only
Option row / selected: radius 4 + check enters with scale/fade; fill #F5F5F5
figmaSteps: Field (Input) State=Open: fill #FFFFFF, border 1px #27ABB8 (--color-secondary-600) + drop shadow x0 y0 blur 4 spread 0 #27ABB8 @ 40%, radius 8, height 40. Same as Focus; stays teal under hover. Disabled unchanged.

Panel: unchanged (radius 8, border 1px #E9EAEB, shadow 0 4 8 -2 rgba(16,24,40,0.10) + 0 2 4 -2 rgba(16,24,40,0.06), 8px below the field, list padding 4, max-height 240px). Add a Position=Above variant: 8px above the field.

Option row: corner radius 4 (was 0). Geometry unchanged: min-height 48, padding 10 top/bottom, 6 left, 36 right, 16/400 #5E5E5E. Hover fill #F5F5F5. Selected: fill #F5F5F5, label #484848, check icon 16px #27ABB8, 12px from the right, vertically centred.
Add variant Keyboard focus: fill #F5F5F5 + inside stroke 1px #27ABB8 (radius 4). Mouse hover does not get the stroke.

Prototype: check enters with opacity 0 to 100% + scale 85% to 100%, 180ms, ease cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1). Panel enters 200ms from opacity 0%, scale 98%, 4px offset toward the field, origin at the corner touching the field.
notes: Check position fix: the old centring used a translate, which the pop keyframe would overwrite and shove the icon 8px down while it plays. It is now centred with auto margins; the resting position is identical.
Origin follows floating-ui's reported placement; the unit tests force placement through a mock (jsdom cannot flip). The real flip is covered by scenario 12 (data-side=top, origin 'left bottom').
'Keep the 120ms exit': there is none. The panel unmounts immediately when closed (V2-MOTION.md); none was added.
No figmaNode: the SearchFilter story has no design.url.

Proposed follow-up, NOT implemented in this pass: a real keyboard model for MultiSelect and SearchFilter (ArrowUp/ArrowDown, Home/End, typeahead, aria-activedescendant). Today both are Tab-only, which is why the keyboard ring below uses a plain focus-visible rule.

Observation, not changed: the selected check uses four different colours today: Select/CreatableSelect #2BBCCA (semantic-brand), Dropdown/SearchFilter #27ABB8 (semantic-border-accent), MultiSelect #343E55 (semantic-primary). Worth unifying in Figma.

Found while verifying motion: `motion-safe:animate-in` is emitted after bare `fade-in-0`/`zoom-in-*` classes and resets --tw-enter-opacity/--tw-enter-scale to initial, so the panel fade and 98% zoom documented in V2-MOTION.md never ran in normal-motion mode (measured at t=0: opacity 1, no scale). Fixed here by prefixing those classes with `motion-safe:` (as Checkbox/TextField already do). The same bare pattern remains in dialog.tsx, toast.tsx, tabs.tsx, date-range-picker.tsx and date-time-picker.tsx (not in this task's files, not individually verified).
